data.name: Viktor
data.gender_notes: Viktor is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word ‘nikē’, meaning victory. The name Viktor is a symbol of triumph and success. The name Viktor carries the meaning “Conqueror, Victorious” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Viktor usually hope their child will grow to embody conqueror, victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of overcoming challenges and achieving victory in spiritual pursuits.
data.etymology: Viktor belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Conqueror, Victorious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Viktor total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
data.cultural_impact: The name Viktor has its roots in Greek mythology, where 'Nike' was the goddess of victory, triumph, and victory. Viktor, as a Christian name, is a reminder of the hoped-for victory over sin and death that Jesus offers. It is a name that resonates with those seeking victory in their personal lives, through perseverance, dedication, and hard work.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Viktor holds immense spiritual significance as it is derived from 'Nike', the Greek goddess of victory. Christians see in this name a reminder of their hope for victory over sin, hardship, and eventually, death. As believers in Jesus, they live in the assurance of His ultimate victory on their behalf and the promise of eternal life. The name Viktor symbolizes the inner strength of the spirit to overcome any obstacles, regardless of their magnitude, through the power of faith and the grace of God.
